candidates.title: Assessment of structural materials in compact fusion reactor design
candidates.notes: Open-access 2025 paper in Frontiers in Nuclear Engineering. Covers ODS steels and SiC/SiC composites for compact fusion. Operating temperatures: ITER ~750K, DEMO ~570K, STEP ~670K, ARC ~850K. ODS identified as 'most promising candidates for high-temperature compact fusion devices.' Does not specifically discuss He Brayton cycle compatibility or >900K operation for MagLIF, but provides the best available open-access materials survey for this gap.

entries.notes: Extracted paper provides relevant ODS/SiC materials context but focuses on ARC-class tokamak (~850K FLiBe blanket) rather than Z-pinch chamber at >900K. The gap asks specifically about He Brayton cycle and C-C composite availability above 900K for MagLIF thermal BOP; the Frontiers paper's thermal efficiency analysis does not directly address this. The z-ife-sand2006-7148-thermal-cycles source (iter-02) remains the primary thermal cycle reference for MagLIF; this new source supplements it with materials TRL context.
